description: Rework the shared public Navbar (spec FIX 6) to match Figma node 451:1151 pixel-accurately. Independent of FEAT-001 (Home page). This navbar is shared site-wide. Figma (RTL) layout on screen: primary navy icon button on the LEFT, nav links centered, logo on the RIGHT — i.e. logically Logo at inline-END, primary button at inline-START, links centered (resolution confirmed against node 451:1151 design context + screenshot; the one-line brief's 'logo inline-start/button inline-end' is superseded by the spec file FIX 6). Remove the SearchBar from the row (451:1151 has no search); remove the visible desktop locale/theme controls (move them into the mobile sheet so the product keeps them).
steps:
In src/components/shared/navbar.tsx remove the SearchBar import and its desktop block entirely (the `
`). Figma 451:1151 has no search field.

Rebuild the desktop row as three zones under `justify-between`: (a) inline-START edge = a single primary navy icon Button — `<Button asChild size="icon"><Link href={routes.login}><GraduationIcon aria-hidden /></Link></Button>` (filled primary is the default variant/appearance; pick GraduationIcon or PersonIcon from @/components/icons; include an aria-label via the Link or an sr-only label using the `nav` namespace, e.g. t('login')). (b) center = the existing <NavLinks links={links} /> centered in the row (use an absolutely-centered wrapper or a 3-column flex so links stay visually centered regardless of the side zones' widths). (c) inline-END edge = <Logo />. Verify this matches the on-screen RTL layout (button left, links center, logo right).

Remove the desktop <LocaleSwitcher /> and <ThemeToggle /> from the visible row. Keep the mobile Sheet; add LocaleSwitcher + ThemeToggle into the Sheet footer (near the existing login/register buttons) so the controls remain available without appearing in the desktop row.

Surface/metrics per Figma 451:1151: header surface solid bg-card (#fafafa) — replace `bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm` with solid `bg-card`; inner container height ~92px (e.g. `min-h-[92px]`), horizontal padding `px-6`; add a bottom border (`border-b border-border`); keep the existing `shadow-card` token; keep `sticky top-0 z-50 w-full`.

Keep i18n: links still built from the `nav` namespace via getTranslations('nav'); keep the mobile Sheet links list and login/register buttons; keep Logo. Do not change the Navbar function signature (it is a shared server component consumed site-wide).

If centering NavLinks cleanly requires it, pass a className through to src/components/shared/nav-links.tsx (it already accepts `className`) rather than changing its props shape — keep it backward-compatible.
acceptance_criteria: No SearchBar is rendered in the navbar; the SearchBar import is removed from navbar.tsx.
Desktop row renders, in RTL, as: primary navy icon button at the inline-START (left on screen), nav links centered, Logo at the inline-END (right on screen); the whole thing mirrors correctly in LTR.
LocaleSwitcher and ThemeToggle do not appear in the desktop row but are present inside the mobile Sheet.
Header is solid bg-card, ~92px tall, px-6, has a bottom border, keeps shadow-card and sticky top-0 z-50.
nav i18n namespace, Logo, and the mobile Sheet (links + login/register) are preserved.
verification: pnpm run typegen; pnpm run typecheck (exit 0)
pnpm run test (all green — search.test.tsx must not break; SearchBar is still exported/used by dashboard-topbar.tsx)
figma get_screenshot on 451:1151 vs the built navbar in RTL (logo right, links centered, navy icon button left, ~92px, bottom border, solid #fafafa); reason about LTR mirroring
